# Legend — proof of concept

Two orthogonal molecular readouts of the same tissue, each checked against the imaging immune
fraction the pipeline exports.

## Panels

@fig:group-contrast   imaging pan-immune fraction by transcriptomic group, six case values
                      overlaid on the boxplots.
@fig:covariation      deconvolution immune fraction against imaging immune fraction, one point
                      per case, at the total-immune tier.
